laws.rule: Anse Major Trail, accessed via Bel Ombre and Danzil: SPGA lists the trail among paid-entry trails for non-resident adults. Keep the valid ticket for ranger checks and follow ranger instructions. On-site entry payment is by card only. The official trail leaflet confirms this Bel Ombre/Danzil access route; it is not a permit for access across all of Morne Seychellois National Park.
